book.title: Mak Makho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yesu Pailatot yangat tonggung

Oro sa isuna öret socsoc amna moröma orin nongoru gendic fandat fandat amna orin surarohon amna dugo yu ambarac irot tungu singmuya Yesuhon matano yu bödegoc. Yu bödeuna yu Yesu yidec kaning yungmuya Gavman amna moröma Pailat yuot tohong yugung.
Tuna Pailatho Yesu inong ac tongga inogoc, “Goc Yuda nanohon king worochu?” Ihoroc inuna Yesuho yogoc, “Öc gaka yarocma woi boinno.”
Ihoroc yuna öret socsoc amna dugo yu mata koböcmaho firing tandung.
Ihoroc tuya Pailatho wönggon Yesu inong ac tongga yogoc, “Kombiharoc, yu gocha mata koböc firing garang. Goc mata worochon urago mayirochu nuhun?”
Ihoroc inogoc mahong Yesu yu öpgon idoc. Worocha tongga Pailatho nangano fadoc.
Pailatho ‘Yesu ep goröcdec wuya ompun’ yongo matano yun bödegoc
Oro, gavmanthon morömahon toroc kiap au ingoroc ididoc: Biruc danong Yuda nanohon bongono morödec suraroho inobut yi bucinma amna auhon mano yuya Pailatho amna woroc asan imuna orung ongidoc.

Oro, bongono wocin wömai amna torop au yu ‘gavman tanaya ongoun’ yongo tawa amnaot emoc tuya tawa amnaho yu yibucin fohong yugung. Tuya emoc amna au mano Barabas yu ihorocgon emoc tongga amna au wot sigocmaha yibucin idoc.
Oro owi amna koböcma sinompho engmuya Pailat inogung, “Gocho toroc kiap biruc danong tongitarocma worochon toroc önga ihorocgon amna au angbanaya orung ongoun.
Ihoroc inuya Pailatho mata urago ingoroc inogoc, “Son tingting kombiang oro, ‘nocho Yuda nanohon king yu woroc asan impiwa’ yongo kombianghu?”

Pailat yu wömai surarohon foro ingoroc kombingbödegoc. Öret socsoc böchon amna dugo yu Yesuha ecego kombigung, yaha yu suraroho yangamin ma moröma sogidocmaha. Foro worocha tongga yu Yesu mata youpdec tohong yungga
surarohon irotno sakangga ingoroc inogung, “Son Pailat kiring imuya yu Barabas asan nimpun” ihoroc inogungmaha suraroho Barabasha yogung.
Ihoroc yuya Pailatho yogoc, “Oro, son Barabasha yangmaha nocho amna ngo son ‘Yuda nanohon king’ ihoroc yongidangma yu tingting tong imontat yo?”
Pailatho ihoroc yuna suraroho ecnang sinom mambodung, “Ep goröcdec wuya ompun.” Ihoroc mambuya Pailatho yogoc,
“Nocu yuhon wontucmuno maat, worocha foro yaha ompun yo?” Pailatho ihoroc yogoc mahong suraroho ecnang sinom mamboto yogung, “Ep goröcdec wuya ompun!”
Ihoroc yuya, Pailatho ‘surarohon irot dongya guc maarut’ yongo Barabas asan imogoc. Tongo yu tawa amna inuna yu Yesu woda ‘ep goröcdec sina’ yongo tohong yugung.
Tawa amnaho Yesu yong kumec imanang imanang yongo wodung
Oro tawa amnaho Yesu yangada gavmanthon böc moröma worochon gombo ganang tonggung. Tongga yu tawa amna nucni ambarac inong yuya engbödegung.
Engga yu Yesu tec tohomunmucno yu temong imogung. Tongo yu yi dirongoni sogitmuya worocdecma amna kinghon tec kutkutno kiap tongo bigodec tohomu möngimogoc.
Oro, ihoroc tongga yu forosingga imanang yongkumec yong imongga yogung, “Sep ogep Yuda nanohon king.”
Tongo kandöng sogitmuya bigodec wotgon tongga irubo yudec sundung. Ihoroc tongga yu goruc yemoc tong imongga imanang yong moröng imogung.
Yu toroc kiap wontucmuno ihorocno tong imongbödengga wönggon tec gomono tuu deuna inoin tec tohomunmucno temong imongga ep goröcdec wotwotha yangat tonggung.
Tawa amnaho Yesu ep goröcdec wodung
Oro, amna au mano Saimon Sairini taundecma, yui Aleksander orin Rufas yuhon fano. Yu öndecma engga taun onggonga tongidina tawa amnaho yu sogida woding tengga Yesuhon ep goröc imuya sumboda tonggoc.
Tuna tawa amnaho Yesu yangada sa au mano Golgata wocin tögung. Sa mano ‘Golgata’ worochon foro, wömai ‘bic kudat’ ihoroc.
Oro, wocin öngkungmuya tawa amnaho Yesu wain yamuc marasin beci sinom tobic tobicyi woroc imogung mahong Yesuho ‘muno’ yongo managoc.
Tuna yu Yesu ep goröcdec wodung. Woroc tongga yu Yesuhon tec napno ‘silip tona’ yongo tim kumec togung.
Oro, sep bongono 9 kilok kembotsumgon bongono wocin yu Yesu ep goröcdec woto sigung.
O ep mondopmodec wömai yu irim au akep togung. Irim wo wömai Yesuhon matanohon yong tuctucno ingoroc, “Ngoi Israel nanohon king,” ihoroc tongo sigung.
Oro Yesuhon obu kandocne o arocne wocin wömai tawa amnaho usem amna yai ep goröcdec dobung.
Yu ihoroc togungmaha tongga Kopotorochon yong tuctuc mata au boinno öngkuboc. Mata woi ingoroc irim toctocyi itac: ‘Suraroho Yesuha kombigung, yu wontucmuno toctoc amna.’ (Aisaia 53:12)
Owi amna sa woce itonggungma yui bic ubung ubung tongmuya Yesu inong saha tongo yogung, “Öhö, goc ngorocho öret socsoc böc gumanmina sep anfiho irodin wönggon tobic tobicha yogorocha.
Oro gocu gaka tongfat yengmina ep goröc imi fauna ohoi.”

Owi amna ihoroc inong saha tong imong idiya öret socsochon amna dugo orin nongoru gendic fandat fandat amna yu ihorocgon inohogon mata inun ganun tongga yogung, “Yu osuc owi amna wontucmunodecma öcangyun muuya itonggong koing imocimocha yongidoc mahong inoin itonggong tun öngkup öngkupha wömai makombic.

O yu inoha yogoc, ‘Noc Duic, o noc Israel nanohon amna morömano king itat.’ Oro yu boinno Duic itacanu wömai yu ep goröc imun fauna ohuna nonu wo angga yu kombing tobing imontamon.” O worochon torocgon wömai usem amna yai Yesuot ep goröcdec dobungma yui ihorocgon Yesu inong saha toup togomoroc.
Yesu omboc
Oro, apmano 12 kilok forosingga sa guroc ambarac kumbong dingga idinagon ongga 3 kilok bödegoc.
Tuna sep bongono 3 kilok idina Yesuho ecnang ingoroc mambodoc, “Eloi, Eloi, Lama Sabaktani!” Mata worochon foro wömai ingoroc: ‘Kopotorocna, Kopotorocna, goc foro yaha noc me namongga imi fahat.’
Ihoroc yuna amna au ambehegon idungma yu mata woroc kombingga yogung, “Kombiarut, yu Elaiya inong yac.”

Ihoroc yuya wohogon amna auho karupgon ongmuna top yat au sogida wain beci yamucdec tomun muuna öngfoc tuna ‘Yesuho nahun’ yongo bokotdec akep tongga Yesu dugodec sorengmun uuna yogoc, “Imana fauna ana, Elaiyaho engga tongfat yeanthachu o munohu?”
Ihoroc yuna Yesu yu ecnang sinom mamboda omong fadoc.
Omong fauna wohogon boru moröma öret socsoc böc irodin idocma worocho onoce singga fuc tongga ohongga mondopmodec omoce bödeuna fugo yai idomoroc.

Oro tawa amnahon ofisano yu Yesu tan itmuna Yesu yaö kiapdec ombocma wo angtangtang togoc. Tongo yu Yesuhon mambocno kombingga ingoroc yong taboc, “Boinno sinom amna ngoi Kopotoroc-hon Manano,” ihoroc yogoc.
Oro owi au yu korungonbum itmuya manomano öngkubocma wo yangbödegung. Owi worochon bonipno-dec wömai Maria Makdala bucinma, o Jems mitma orin Yosishon macno, o owi au mano Salome yu woce idung.

Owi wo yu wömai Yesu Galili gurocin itongidocan yuot itongmuya nacno manomanoha mongorec tong imongidung. Oro owi worocot wömai owi torop moröma auot yu Yesu tanda Yerusalem engmuya sa woce ida Yesu ombocma wo agung.
Yösep yu Yesuhon ep fambangno tongo sop ganangodec tohong sigoc
Oro Sabathon manomano tong arangarang toctochon sep youp toctoc bongono idina dobocsisia

amna au mano Yösep yu eboc. Yuhon böcsano woi Arimatea. Yu wömai Yuda nanohon kaunsil memba au idoc. O yu ‘Kopotorochon toborucno urop ehantac’ yongo worocha torengga ididoc. Oro amna wo yu Pailatha mabotogoc, muno yu koing songga ‘Yesuhon ep fambangno sogida oring siwa’ yongo Pailatot ongmuna inong ac togoc.
Inuna Pailatho irot yai tongga yogoc, “Yesu urop omechu nuhun?” Tongo yu tawa amnahon ofisano inong yuna ehuna Pailatho inogoc, “Yesu yu urop omecha woha muno?”
Ihoroc inuna ofisaho ‘urop ompac’ yuna Pailatho Yösep ‘öc’ inongo “Yesuhon ep fambangno ogep sogiantaroc.”

Ihoroc inuna Yösep yu ongga boru sacsago au wöngga Yesu ep fambangno ep goröcdecma tuhun deuna boru sacsagodec tombot-muna sumboda tongga amna ficfichon sop ganango au wocin sigoc. Tongo yu sop moröma ibaruna ongga sop momböngno foctongmun fauna onggoc.
Ihoroc tuna Maria Makdala bucinma orin Yosishon macno Maria, yu wocin itmunya aunya Yesu ep fambangno sa nahenne sigocno wo agomoroc.
